# Xahau minting fixtures: findings

Recorded 2026-10-30 from `wss://xahau.network` (xahaud 2026.10.13-release+4119, network id 21337; validated head 26905635) with `--txs` and `--ledgers`: two `Import` transactions and their parent ledgers (4 ledgers), found through `account_tx`, not by a scan (see the README section "Xahau minting"). 55 requests in all, one in flight at a time. Beside them are two hand-made ledgers (`26540187-opt-out.json`, `26540188-governance.json`). Every fact says how it was checked, with throwaway scripts (not in the repository) on the recorded ledgers, on the node and on the xahaud source at its tag.

The xahaud source below is the tag `2026.10.13-release+4119` (commit `d20e8ffb561034101d24668adbe9a513f639cb37`, the build `server_info` reports), file paths and line numbers as that commit has them, read on GitHub (`github.com/Xahau/xahaud`) on 2026-10-30.

## Facts

1. The opt-out bit and how xahaud reads it:
   - `tfOptOut = 0x00000001`, `enum ClaimRewardFlags` in `include/xrpl/protocol/TxFlags.h:230-234` (not `src/xrpld/protocol/TxFlags.h`, which that commit does not have), with `tfClaimRewardMask = ~(tfUniversal | tfOptOut)`.
   - `src/xrpld/app/tx/detail/ClaimReward.cpp` tests it by equality, not by mask: `bool isOptOut = flags && *flags == tfOptOut;` (`:127` in `preclaim`, `:202` in `doApply`).
   - An opt-out claim has no `Issuer` and any other claim must have one: `if ((issuer && isOptOut) || (!issuer && !isOptOut)) return temMALFORMED;` (`:124-129`). So on a ledger an opt-out claim has `Flags` exactly 1 and no `Issuer`.
   - A `Flags` of 0x80000001 (`tfUniversal` too) is not an opt-out for xahaud: without `Issuer` it is `temMALFORMED` (never in a ledger), with an `Issuer` it is a normal claim. `Flags & 1` and `Flags === 1` therefore give the same answer for every claim that can be in a ledger except 0x80000001 with an `Issuer`; none was seen in the recordings.
   - No real opt-out claim is recorded (see "Not found"): the one recorded `ClaimReward` (`3A1F25CD…`, ledger 26540187 of `xahau/recorded`) has `Flags` 0 and an `Issuer`.
2. Xahau's first ledger is fact 1 of `packages/shared/test/fixtures/xahau/uritoken/FINDINGS.md` (cited at `network-profile.ts:56-60`; the profile has `firstLedger: 1` at `:148`), not derived again. `server_info.complete_ledgers` of `https://xahau.network` on 2026-10-30 13:25 UTC was `1-26905606`, and the committed `server_info.json` of this directory (13:27 UTC) says `1-26905635`: it still starts at 1, the same as the profile.
3. F5 (an `Import` credits whatever the result of its inner XRPL transaction), from `src/xrpld/app/tx/detail/Import.cpp`:
   - `preflight` lets a `tec` inner result through: `tesSUCCESS` passes (`:226-229`), `innerResult >= tecCLAIM && innerResult <= tecLAST_POSSIBLE_ENTRY` passes with the comment "proof of burn on account set can be done with a tec code" (`:230-234`); anything else is `temMALFORMED` (`:235-241`).
   - `doApply` credits from the inner transaction's `Fee` alone: `STAmount burn = stpTrans->getFieldAmount(sfFee);` (`:1285`), `uint64_t creditDrops = burn.xrp().drops();` (`:1328`). It does not look at the inner result's value before it (only that the field is present, `:1272-1273`): the credit is 1:1 for the first 2,000,000 ledgers after `XahauActivationLgrSeq` (`:1335-1339`), then declines linearly over 28,000,000 ledgers (`:1340-1347`), is 0 afterwards (`:1348-1353`), and is 0 whenever the amendment `ZeroB2M` is enabled (`:1330-1334`).
   - The inner result is read once, after the balance is set, to decide whether keys are imported: `if (isTesSuccess(meta->getFieldU8(sfTransactionResult)))` (`:1409`, a `SignerListSet` or `SetRegularKey` inner transaction). So an `Import` with a `tec` inner transaction credits, and what it does not do is import keys.
   - An account the `Import` creates starts at `computeStartingBonus` (`startBal`, `:1324-1326`; `Import.h:37-72`: reserve base + 5 × reserve increment, 1,000,000 + 5 × 200,000 = 2,000,000 on Xahau); an existing one starts at its balance after the fee (`mSourceBalance`; the recorded case: 1,000,000 − 100 = 999,900, plus 11 = 999,911). `finalBal = startBal + credit` (`:1355`), and the header grows by what was added: `STAmount added = create ? finalBal : finalBal - startBal; ctx_.rawView().rawDestroyXRP(-added.xrp());` (`:1419-1420`). So minted = final `Balance` − previous `Balance` + the `Fee` the `Import` itself paid, and for a created account `Balance` + `Fee`.
   - A first `Import` pays no fee: an account that does not exist must have `Fee` 0 (`:1001-1002`, `temBAD_FEE` otherwise) and `calculateBaseFee` is 0 for an account that does not exist when the transaction has no `Issuer` (`:1428-1430`). An `Import` into an existing account pays its `Fee`.
   - No recorded `Import` has a `tec` inner transaction (see "Not found"), so the `tec` half of F5 rests on the source.
4. The two recorded `Import`s, with the credit worked out from the XRPL transaction in each `Blob` (decoded with `ripple-binary-codec`; the `Blob` is the hex of the JSON XPOP, whose `transaction.blob` is the inner transaction):
   - `A7390ED8…` (ledger 24508587, `rBPKXGERk7KrzZDGXscchv4eQoS2k6nV6M`): the inner transaction is an `AccountSet` (XRPL ledger 105772987) with `Fee` 12, result `tesSUCCESS`, `Sequence` 87209874 (the account's `ImportSequence`). The credit is 0 because `ZeroB2M` is enabled: the `Amendments` object at ledger 24508586 (73 amendments) holds `7CA0426E7F411D39BB014E57CD9E08F61DE1750F0D41FCD428D9FB80BB7596B0`, the first 32 bytes of SHA-512 of "ZeroB2M", and the one at ledger 2609052 (39 amendments) does not. Without `ZeroB2M` the schedule would have credited 2 drops (elapsed 24,508,584, `y` = 1 − 22,508,584 / 28,000,000 = 0.196, 12 × 0.196 = 2.35). The new `AccountRoot` has `Balance` 2000000 = the starting bonus (`FeeSettings` in its metadata: `ReserveBaseDrops` 1000000, `ReserveIncrementDrops` 200000), `AccountIndex` 33636 and `ImportSequence`; the `FeeSettings` node's `AccountCount` goes from 33636 to 33637.
   - `39524397…` (ledger 2609053, `rTeLeproT3BVgjWoYrDYpKbBLXPaVMkge`): the inner transaction is a `SetRegularKey` (XRPL ledger 85626110) with `Fee` 12, result `tesSUCCESS`, `Sequence` 85626019. `FeeSettings` at ledger 2609052 has `XahauActivationLgrSeq` 3, so elapsed is 2,609,050 and `y` = 1 − 609,050 / 28,000,000 = 0.97825; 12 × 0.97825 = 11.74, cut to 11 drops. The account's `Balance` went from 1000000 to 999911 = +11 − the `Import`'s `Fee` of 100. The same node holds `RegularKey` (the imported key) and `ImportSequence` 85626019 in its final fields. Its first transaction was a `Payment` in ledger 2608942 (111 ledgers earlier).
5. F2 by hand, the sum of the `GenesisMint` amounts and the `Import` credits of a ledger against the change of `total_coins` from its parent plus the `Fee` of every transaction of the ledger (`fee_total`):
   - 24508586 to 24508587: `total_coins` 652836840160349 to 652836841605625, change 1,445,276; the 127 transactions (83 `Payment`, 43 `URITokenBuy`, 1 `Import`) paid 554,724; 1,445,276 + 554,724 = 2,000,000. Minted: the `Import` 2,000,000 (`CreatedNode` `Balance` 2,000,000 + `Fee` 0), no `GenesisMint`: 2,000,000. Equal.
   - 2609052 to 2609053: `total_coins` 600351935750436 to 600351935750325, change −111; the 3 transactions (`Import`, `URITokenCreateSellOffer`, `Payment`) paid 122; −111 + 122 = 11. Minted: the `Import` 999,911 − 1,000,000 + 100 = 11, no `GenesisMint`: 11. Equal.
   - 26540187 to 26540188 (`xahau/recorded`, the spec's F2): change 15,852,989, `fee_total` 14,122, sum 15,867,111 = the one `GenesisMint`'s 8 amounts. Equal. The two hand-made ledgers keep these totals, so the pair holds in them too.
6. The `Import` metadata a parser reads (in these two): for a creation the `AccountRoot` is a `CreatedNode` whose `NewFields.Account` is the transaction's `Account`, with `Balance` (the starting bonus plus the credit) and no `PreviousFields`; for an existing account a `ModifiedNode` with `PreviousFields.Balance` (here also `Flags` and `Sequence`). The transaction has `Blob`, `Fee` and `Account`. A `FeeSettings` `ModifiedNode` (`AccountCount`) comes with the creation only.

## The hand-made files

- `26540187-opt-out.json`: the ledger `xahau/recorded/26540187.json.gz` with the `ClaimReward` `3A1F25CD…` changed from `Flags` 0 to `Flags` 1 and its `Issuer` removed, as an opt-out must be (fact 1), and nothing else (a deep diff against the recorded ledger shows those two differences). Its metadata is still that of the normal claim; the parser reads only the transaction. Case `claim-opt-out`.
- `26540188-governance.json`: the ledger `xahau/recorded/26540188.json.gz` with the `GenesisMint` `E8264F11…`'s `EmitDetails.EmitParentTxnID` changed from the claim `3A1F25CD…` to `DE1FEAEA69ABF97EA8D95341A6C9B79094746CD8F35C0557583BB986867BB48D`, the recorded `Invoke` of ledger 26540711 (`xahau/recorded`), which is no `ClaimReward`, and nothing else (a deep diff shows that one difference). Case `genesis-mint-governance`.
- Both keep the ledger hash and the transaction hashes of the real ledgers. Nothing records 26540187 or 26540188 into this directory (a second file with the same index would make `FixtureLedgerSource.fromDir` throw "Duplicate ledger"), so a test of the invariant that must not use them leaves them out by file name.

## Not found

- `claim-opt-out`, as a real transaction: no `ClaimReward` with `Flags` 1 is recorded. The only claim seen (ledger 26540187 of `xahau/recorded`) has `Flags` 0, and none was searched for beyond it under the bounds of one request at a time. Hand-made: `26540187-opt-out.json`.
- `genesis-mint-governance`, as a real transaction: no `GenesisMint` whose parent is no `ClaimReward`. The only mint seen (ledger 26540188 of `xahau/recorded`) has the claim as its parent. Hand-made: `26540188-governance.json`.
- `import-inner-tec`: no recorded `Import` has a `tec` inner XRPL transaction; both inner results are `tesSUCCESS`. The 41 accounts with an `ImportSequence` were only read at their first three transactions. Not hand-made (for the parser an `Import` with a `tec` inner transaction is one more `Import` with `tesSUCCESS`, which it reads by the balance); F5 rests on the source (fact 3).
- `import-creates-account-with-credit`: no recorded `Import` both creates an account and has a burn credit above 0. `ZeroB2M` is on at 24508587 (fact 4), so that `Import`'s minted amount is the starting bonus alone; the credit-bearing case is `import-existing-account` (11 drops).
- `account-delete`: no `AccountDelete` on Xahau is recorded. The plan's case was dropped (nothing reads it); `xrpl/account-state/` and `xrpl/recorded/` hold XRPL ones.
